pages.title: The First Customer
pages.text: Sell an eligible shipment through the shipping box.

pages.title: The First Customer
pages.text: See a real sale and its quoted price.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Check eligibility and price in the normal economy interface, put the goods in the Shipping Box and complete the sale. Merely placing items in the box is not enough.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Shipping accepts admitted goods and commits a real sale; a quote is not payment.
